item.title: CMU Trash Pick-Up For Monday
item.description: Chillicothe Municipal Utilities will be closed on Monday for the President’s Day holiday. Because of the holiday, Chillicothe residents with a Monday Trash Route will need to wait to put out their trash until Tuesday. Monday’s Trash Routes in Chillicothe will be picked up on Tuesday, along with the regular Tuesday routes.

item.title: Texas Man Arrested In Daviess County
item.description: A Texas man was arrested by State Troopers in Daviess County Friday afternoon. Fifty-four-year-old John E. Hollar of Melissa, TX, was arrested at 12:11 pm for alleged DWI, Careless and Imprudent Driving, and Leaving the Scene of an Accident. He was taken to the Daviess Dekalb Regional Jail.

item.title: Salisbury Man Injured In Single Vehicle Crash
item.description: A Salisbury man had minor injuries in a single-vehicle crash Saturday morning. A 49-year-old man was westbound on US 24, six miles east of Salisbury, when he ran off the road and struck a utility pole. He was not wearing a safety belt and was treated for minor injuries at the scene.

item.title: Trenton Woman Arrested For Alleged DWI
item.description: A Trenton woman was arrested by State Troopers in Grundy County Sunday evening. At about 7:10 pm, Troopers arrested 20-year-old Erica N. Lovett for alleged DWI. She was processed and released with a summons to appear in court.
